newsitem.title: USA: Warner Bros. negotiation period expires.
newsitem.headline: Warner Bros. negotiation period expires.

text.p: Warner Bros. said Tuesday that it has allowed its exclusive negotiation period with New Regency to expire.
The company said in a statement that it considered the terms of the equity investment that New Regency has been seeking "simply exceeds what Warner Bros. is willing to pay."

Nevertheless, "We look forward to our on-going relationship marketing and distributing New Regency's entire library worldwide under the terms of our current long-term agreement, up to and including those films being put into production through June 1998," the company said. "We have, and hope to continue to enjoy, a long-term and mutually beneficial relationship with New Regency."
